 Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
 Pearland, TX
 Phone 346-555-7901
 Letter of Representation
December 5, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1173
Our client: James Powell
Date of loss: October 26, 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our
client was lawfully stopped at a traffic signal. Our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and
treatment, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and associated losses to be documented in the coming weeks.
Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by
telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already spoken with our client,
please let us know so that we can address it.
We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage
limits applicable to this claim, as well as any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.
Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash
camera or telematics records, claim file notes, recorded statements, and any communications with your insured. Please confirm in
writing that these materials will be retained.
Sincerely,
Andrew Lewis
Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
